review_basis: Existing accepted extraction only; no source PDFs, mark schemes or images opened

decisions.rationale: All three marked cells construct neutral ionic formulae from supplied charges; no bonding explanation is assessed.
decisions.review: Mg2+ needs two NO3−; two Li+ balance SO4²−; Al3+ and PO4³− pair 1:1. Brackets only for repeated nitrate. All three marks remain one intact table record.

decisions.rationale: The three cells assess charge-balanced formula construction with all ion charges supplied.
decisions.review: Na+/Cl− gives NaCl; Mg2+/Cl− gives MgCl2; Mg2+/N3− gives Mg3N2. Preserve historical formatting and reversed-order allowances in original fields.

decisions.rationale: Only coefficients of supplied formulae earn the mark; the record does not calculate a mole amount.
decisions.review: 3:2:1:6 conserves Ca3 P2 H12 O14. Source permits equivalent multiples/fractions. No alteration to empirical 7-8 classification.

decisions.rationale: Both marked operations are equation coefficients and states with formulae supplied; no redox reasoning is asked.
decisions.review: 2H2S(g)+SO2(g)→3S(s)+2H2O(l) conserves H4 S3 O2. Gases and liquid water follow extracted ordinary laboratory context; retain indivisible two-mark record.

decisions.rationale: All required responses are state symbols beside supplied formulae; diffusion is context, not this leaf’s scored reasoning.
decisions.review: NH3(g)+HCl(g)⇌NH4Cl(s) has conserved atoms. All three states required for one mark. Source empirical band 9 is retained even though teaching state-symbol activity is 5-6.

decisions.rationale: Reactant and both product names are explicitly supplied; the marked response is their formula equation, not prediction of an alkene reaction.
decisions.review: C2H4Cl2→C2H3Cl+HCl conserves C2 H4 Cl2. Historical case/format allowances remain source data, not new activity marking rules.

decisions.rationale: Named products calcium hydroxide and phosphine are supplied; formula translation and balancing are the two directly marked operations.
decisions.review: Ca3P2+6H2O→3Ca(OH)2+2PH3 conserves Ca3 P2 H12 O6. Phosphine formula PH3 is supplied; calcium hydroxide is ionic construction, supporting 16.1 secondary. Source formula dependency retained.

decisions.rationale: The balanced equation is supplied; marks assess a limiting-reagent comparison, not formula/equation construction.
decisions.review: 3.20/27≈0.119 mol Al versus 0.120×2/3=0.080 mol required confirms acid limiting. A supplied ratio does not justify a new 16.2 tag.

decisions.rationale: Method choice and reactivity justification remain the dominant skill; a balanced lead-forming equation is an explicit third requirement.
decisions.review: Retain all three marks under 13.1 once, with no fabricated subparts. 2PbO+C→2Pb+CO2, PbO+CO→Pb+CO2 and PbO+C→Pb+CO each conserve atoms. Equation component warrants 16.2 secondary.

decisions.rationale: Extracted context and supplied-recall tags identify all products; marked formulae and coefficients assess translating a stated hydrate decomposition, not predicting nitrate products.
decisions.review: 2Zn(NO3)2·6H2O→2ZnO+4NO2+O2+12H2O conserves Zn2 N4 H24 O24, treating six waters per hydrate formula unit. Adequate extraction includes reactant coefficient and product names; no source reopening required.

decisions.rationale: Selecting ion charges from a supplied formula does not construct an ionic compound formula; keep ionic bonding primary.
decisions.review: 3Ca2+ and 2PO4³− give +6 and −6, but the assessed answer is the pair of ion charges, not Ca3(PO4)2. Boundary avoids tagging every ion recall item as new Formulae.

decisions.rationale: The assessed cathode half-equation is specifically excluded from the new neutral whole-equation scope, including its state-symbol component.
decisions.review: Pb2++2e−→Pb conserves charge and lead. Preserve historical Pb(s)/Pb(l) allowances and corrupted new-fact text verbatim in original; that fact is not imported or endorsed. No 16.2 tag.
